2609.10266.title: KVShareArena: KV-Cache Reuse Across Contexts and Model Checkpoints
2609.10266.paper_summary: LLM serving systems already reuse KV caches, but only when the reused text sits at the very start of the prompt. Two growing workloads break this condition: a retrieval-augmented generation server assembles a different set of retrieved chunks for every query, and a multi-agent coordinator reads reports written by other agents. Reused inside a new prompt, a cache carries the wrong positions and never attended to the other sources. The cache may also have been written by a different checkpoint of the same model family, which changes the stored values. Repair methods for such caches have appeared in three separate communities, each measured on its own terms, and existing benchmarks test only exact-prefix reuse, where nothing is lost. KVShareArena benchmarks KV-cache reuse across prompt contexts and model checkpoints on retrieved chunks and agent reports. It scores every method by the fraction of the gap it recovers between no cache and full recomputation, and charges compute, memory, and per-request latency with the cache in hand, reporting the one-time cost of building a cache separately. We find that correcting positions, which needs no recomputation, is enough until a question needs several sources at once. There, only methods that pay, by re-encoding part of the cache or by training, recover half to two thirds of the gap; unrepaired caches can be worse than no cache. Cache-compression methods that are harmless on a single prompt fall significantly behind position correction on freshly written agent reports. These patterns hold across three model boards. When a different checkpoint wrote the cache, training-free methods are barely affected, while an adapter trained on one checkpoint's caches loses quality. Harness, frozen querysets, and cost accounting ship as a pip package with an automated submission workflow and a public leaderboard.
2609.10266.paper_summary_zh: LLM 服務系統已經重複使用 KV 快取，但僅在重複的文本位於提示的最開頭時。兩個增長的工作負載打破了這一條件：檢索增強生成伺服器為每個查詢組裝一組不同的檢索片段，而多代理協調器則閱讀其他代理撰寫的報告。在新的提示中重複使用的快取攜帶了錯誤的位置，並且從未考慮到其他來源。該快取也可能是由同一模型系列的不同檢查點寫入的，這會改變存儲的值。此類快取的修復方法已在三個不同的社群中出現，每個社群都以自己的標準進行衡量，現有基準僅測試精確前綴重用，這樣不會丟失任何內容。KVShareArena 在檢索片段和代理報告的提示上下文和模型檢查點之間基準測試 KV 快取重用。它根據恢復無快取和完全重新計算之間的差距的比例為每種方法打分，並計算使用快取時的計算、內存和每請求延遲，並單獨報告構建快取的一次性成本。我們發現，修正位置不需要重新計算，直到一個問題需要同時使用多個來源。在那裡，只有通過重新編碼部分快取或訓練來支付的方式，才能恢復一半到三分之二的差距；未修復的快取可能比沒有快取更糟。對單一提示無害的快取壓縮方法在新寫的代理報告上顯著落後於位置修正。這些模式在三個模型板上保持一致。當不同的檢查點寫入快取時，無需訓練的方法幾乎不受影響，而在一個檢查點的快取上訓練的適配器則會失去質量。Harness、凍結查詢集和成本核算作為 pip 包與自動提交工作流程和公共排行榜一起提供。
2609.10266.author: Xi Shi et.al.
